posts.title: Solid-state batteries
posts.summary: The rise of the lithium-ion battery, which powers everything from the smallest personal electronics to gargantuan energy storage systems, has been nothing short of revolutionary. But as anyone who’s boarded a plane in the last decade could tell you, storing and pumping out energy by moving charged lithium ions through a liquid electrolyte soup has…
bullets: Solid-state batteries replace liquid electrolytes with solid ceramics or polymers to improve energy density, safety, and charging speeds while reducing fire risks.
Manufacturing at scale remains the primary barrier, as the production of defect-free ceramic electrolytes requires specialized dry-room environments and high-precision assembly.

QuantumScape and other developers are working to overcome dendrite formation—needlelike filaments that short-circuit cells—with most industry experts projecting price parity with lithium-ion by the mid-2030s.

posts.title: Accelerate Yield Ramp with Closed-Loop Yield Learning
posts.summary:
An analytics-driven approach leveraging integrated industry leading technologies targeting advanced node devices.
The post Accelerate Yield Ramp with Closed-Loop Yield Learning appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: Closed-loop yield learning is becoming essential for advanced node production to minimize time-to-market and reduce the high costs associated with yield loss.
Advanced analytics-driven diagnostics allow engineers to reverse-engineer test failures from automatic test equipment (ATE) to pinpoint precise failure locations within a chip.
By ranking failure candidates based on yield impact, manufacturers can prioritize root-cause analysis and implement corrective actions in either design or process flows more efficiently.

posts.title: CATL shares fall over 10% in Hong Kong as tax changes add to profit pressure
posts.summary:
CATL's Hong Kong shares fell to their lowest since July 2025 after third-quarter net profit declined 5.77% from the previous quarter.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: CATL shares dropped over 10% following a 5.77% sequential decline in third-quarter net profit, despite a 58.58% year-on-year revenue increase.
Profitability is being squeezed by new government consumption taxes on lithium batteries and the reduction of export tax rebates.
Management is currently negotiating cost-sharing arrangements with customers to mitigate the impact of these tax policy changes on unit margins.

posts.title: China NEV retail sales fall 13% in first 18 days of October, penetration rebounds to 65.9%
posts.summary:
China's passenger NEV retail sales totaled 520,000 units from October 1 to 18, down 13% year-on-year and 2% from the same period last month.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: China's passenger NEV retail sales reached 520,000 units in the first 18 days of October, representing a 13% year-on-year decline.
NEV penetration reached 65.9% during this period, showing a rebound from early October levels but remaining below the record 67% seen in September.
The broader passenger car market is facing significant headwinds, with retail sales falling 26% year-on-year and daily sales trends weakening throughout the month.

posts.title: Netflix Earnings, Business or Franchise, Disney’s Deal
posts.summary: Netflix has a solid business, which is exactly the problem: the company increasingly seems like a business and not a franchise, at least in terms of growth.
bullets: Netflix is facing a growth plateau where it is increasingly viewed as a standard business rather than a high-growth franchise.
The analysis highlights the difficulty for mature streaming platforms to maintain the explosive growth metrics expected by public markets.
The content suggests that the transition from a growth-oriented tech company to a stable media business creates significant valuation challenges for investors.
